01 / THE INTENT

Live a little wider
Keep it personal

This personal project explores freedom through everyday enjoyment. Instead of building a complicated plot, the short brings attention to the atmosphere, the ease of being present and the individual character inside each moment.

The aim is to test how far AI can produce cinematic footage—and whether it can express the idea and feeling intended by its director.

02 / CREATIVE DIRECTION

A frame follows

Keep the emotional centre in moments that feel lived, relaxed and personal.

04 / CREATIVE EXPLORATION
Small moments, a wider life

The creative test is whether AI can express a specific personal mood, beyond producing attractive images. Framing, movement and editing are treated as one language for freedom, enjoyment and individuality.
